# OmniAlign-V: Towards Enhanced Alignment of MLLMs with Human Preference

Xiangyu Zhao $^{1,2*}$ Shengyuan Ding $^{2,3*}$ Zicheng Zhang $^{1,2}$

Haian Huang² Maosong Cao² Weiyun Wang²,⁴ Jiaqi Wang² Xinyu Fang²,⁵

Wenhai Wang $^{2}$ Guangtao Zhai $^{1,2}$ Haodong Duan $^{2\dagger}$ Hua Yang $^{1,2\dagger}$ Kai Chen $^{2\dagger}$

Institute of Image Communication and Network Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University<sup>1</sup>

Shanghai AI Laboratory $^{2}$ Nanjing University $^{3}$ Fudan University $^{4}$ Zhejiang University $^{5}$

![](images/081f3791503d2cfe8f24badc7f0c1f3e57041edb98d3cc8980eaa8629d68ba8e.jpg)  
Figure 1: OmniAlign-V consists of curated images paired with open-ended, comprehensive question-answer pairs, significantly improving the alignment of MLLMs with human preferences. Additionally, we introduce MM-AlignBench, a human-annotated, high-quality benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the ability of MLLMs to align with human values.
